design: 2x2 factorial on all-global A5: per-head Q/K RMS norm off/on; per-query, per-head SDPA output gate off/on
normalization: Reuse frozen HeadNorm: fp32 RMS with epsilon1e-6, learned head-dimension weight, before chain-reset RoPE; this is not the exact L2 plus scalar-temperature QKNorm paper implementation
gate: 2*sigmoid(W_g*attention_normalized_input+b_g), after SDPA and before output projection; W_g=b_g=0; initial output exactly A5, bounded0..2; fixed residual0.1 unchanged
initialization: random from the identical seeded parent; no screening or confirmation checkpoint continuation
data_format: unchanged original V8; byte-identical original fixed10% index; no new records or label/schema changes
qualification: all five variants must pass three maxlen2048 micro32 real updates and unchanged85% peak-memory gate before training
original_control: Fresh A0 one-epoch micro32 control as well as fresh all-global A5(C0); old micro56 or three-epoch-schedule checkpoints are not matched primary controls
interaction: C3-C2-C1+C0 at the final matched one-epoch endpoint
screening: screen partition only, final step1276; inspect CDR AAR, AUROC/AUPRC, original CE composite, full-chain AAR/validity/length together; no best-checkpoint or best-seed selection
inference: one-seed screening is exploratory, never a stable-improvement claim; prior stable thresholds are unchanged; the already inspected confirm partition is not a new untouched holdout for future candidates
